name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-giant-pipes
title: Super Mario World - Giant Pipes
description:
A set of pipes but upscaled to be three tiles wide instead of two not unlike the giant pipes from Giant Land in Super Mario Bros 3.

If you need four tiles wide pipes, please download them from this submission.

Note that the vertical pipes aren't fully functional and depend on custom blocks which don't exist (yet).
